# HorizontalStackedBarChart

## Overview

A complete horizontal stacked bar chart visualization that combines ChartHeader, ChartLegend, DataDisplay, HorizontalStackedBarGroup, and ChartFooter components. Wrapped with ChartAccessibility for screen reader support.

**This component follows the [Organized Props Pattern](./OrganizedPropsPattern.md).**

## Figma Reference

- **Node ID**: `259:6430`
- **Design File**: DataVis-Components
- **Figma URL**: https://www.figma.com/design/uA5ExvS0cNXbDEKzT9Rnrt/DataVis-Components?node-id=259-6430

## Architecture

```
HorizontalStackedBarChart (flex column, gap from Dimensions/Spacings/5)
├── ChartAccessibility (wrapper with ARIA)
│   └── ChartHeader (if chartHeader=true)
│       ├── ChartTitle
│       └── ChartSubtitle
│   └── ChartLegend (if chartLegend=true, auto-generated from series)
│       └── ChartKey[] (up to 6 with categorical colors)
│   └── DataDisplay (if dataDisplay=true)
│       ├── mainLabel (inline typography tokens)
│       ├── DataHead (leadValue + supportingValue)
│       │   ├── DataLead
│       │   └── SupportingData
│       └── DataBadgeSemantic (badge with icon)
│   └── barGroupWrapper (flex: 1)
│       └── HorizontalStackedBarGroup
│           ├── contentWrapper
│           │   └── HorizontalStackedBar[] (for each category)
│           ├── XAxis (optional)
│           └── HoverBadge (optional)
│   └── ChartFooter (if chartFooter=true)
│       └── annotationLeft + annotationRight
```

## Canonical Default Render

> **This is what consumers should get when they request a `HorizontalStackedBarChart` without supplying extra detail.** It is the spec: the `Default` story in `HorizontalStackedBarChart.stories.tsx` matches this exactly, and any future change to the canonical baseline must update the story, this section, and the meta `docs.description` together.

### What's ON by default

| Part                               | Default                 | Why                                                                                                             |
| ---------------------------------- | ----------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ChartHeader`                      | **ON**                  | Title + subtitle anchor the chart so the reader knows what they're looking at                                   |
| `ChartLegend`                      | **ON**                  | Stacked-series charts always need the per-series colour key (segment identity isn't legible otherwise)          |
| `barGroupConfig.categoryLabel`     | **ON**                  | Category labels in the left gutter identify each row — horizontal layout's main strength: long labels have room |
| `barGroupConfig.hoverBadge`        | **ON**                  | Cursor-following `DataBadge` for per-segment value reveal — always paired with `hoverType: "individual"` below  |
| `barGroupConfig.hoverType`         | **`"individual"`**      | Per-segment focus on hover so the hoverBadge surfaces the specific segment's value, not just the bar total      |
| `ChartFooter`                      | **ON**                  | Slot for source / footnote annotations                                                                          |
| `interactive`                      | **ON** (default `true`) | Bars / segments receive hover / click / focus handlers                                                          |
| `barGroupConfig.barHeight`         | **`"M"`**               | Default bar thickness (cross-axis)                                                                              |
| `barGroupConfig.barWidthMode`      | **`"relative"`**        | Real-magnitude stacking; switch to `"fullWidth"` only for 100% stacked / composition charts                     |

### What's OFF by default (opt-in only)

| Part                                                  | When to enable                                                                                                                                                  |
| ----------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `barGroupConfig.rightLabelOutside`                    | Opt in when the per-bar total should be legible without reading the X-axis — the canonical example above turns this on explicitly                              |
| `barGroupConfig.xAxis`                                | Opt in for a quantitative reference for the bar totals (ticks share the bar group's D3 scale) — the canonical example above turns this on explicitly            |
| `dataDisplay`                                         | Only when the chart is paired with a primary KPI / summary surface that benefits from a static or hover-driven `DataDisplay` block above the bars               |
| `barGroupConfig.barWidthMode: "fullWidth"`            | 100% stacked / composition charts (market share, allocation, mix shift) where every bar should reach full width and segments are proportions                    |
| Non-default `hoverType` (`"group"` / `"categorical"`) | Switch to `"group"` when the bar-as-unit is the right interaction target, or `"categorical"` (same series across bars) for series comparison                    |
| `animated`                                            | Datasets that change at runtime (filters, scenario toggles)                                                                                                     |
| `seriesOrder` / `valueFormat` / `dataSort`            | Domain-specific ordering / formatting / sorting needs                                                                                                           |
| `categoryLabelMaxLines` / `categoryLabelMaxWidth`     | Very long category names that need word-wrap or a fixed-width gutter                                                                                            |
| `overflowType: "all"`                                 | Long datasets where every datapoint must remain visible (per-bar slot collapses below the resolved `barHeight`); leave default `"truncated"` for fixed surfaces |
| `accessibility.enabled`                               | Production charts (always opt in for shipped charts; off in this default for the rendered Storybook demo)                                                       |

### Minimal canonical example

```tsx
<HorizontalStackedBarChart
  data={canonicalData}
  chartHeader
  chartLegend
  chartFooter
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: "Quarterly revenue by product.",
    chartSubtitleValue: "Stacked segments show each product's contribution to total revenue.",
  }}
  barGroupConfig={{
    categoryLabel: true,
    rightLabelOutside: true,
    xAxis: true,
    barHeight: "M",
    hoverBadge: true,
    hoverType: "individual",
  }}
  chartFooterConfig={{
    annotationLeftValue: "Source: Jio.",
    annotationRightValue: "FY 2024.",
  }}
/>
```

> **Authoring rule:** when a consumer (human or LLM) asks for "a HorizontalStackedBarChart" without further detail, render the example above — _not_ the `Anatomy` story (everything turned on at once). Anatomy exists as a reference; the default is what ships in real product surfaces.

## Import

```tsx
import { HorizontalStackedBarChart } from "./charts/HorizontalStackedBarChart";
```

## Data Formats

The `category` field accepts `string`, `number`, or `Date` via the `CategoryValue` type (`type CategoryValue = string | number | Date`). All three types are handled transparently.

### Canonical Format (Recommended)

```typescript
import { ChartSeriesDataPoint } from "../types/chart-data";

const data: ChartSeriesDataPoint[] = [
  { category: "Q1", series: "Product A", value: 30 },
  { category: "Q1", series: "Product B", value: 25 },
  { category: "Q2", series: "Product A", value: 35 },
  { category: "Q2", series: "Product B", value: 30 },
];
```

### Legacy Format (Deprecated)

```typescript
const legacyData: HorizontalStackedDataPoint[] = [
  {
    label: "Q1",
    segments: [
      { value: 30, label: "Product A" },
      { value: 25, label: "Product B" },
    ],
  },
  {
    label: "Q2",
    segments: [
      { value: 35, label: "Product A" },
      { value: 30, label: "Product B" },
    ],
  },
];
```

### ChartHeaderConfig

```typescript
type ChartHeaderConfig = Pick<
  ChartHeaderProps,
```

### ChartLegendConfig

```typescript
interface ChartLegendConfig {
  items?: ChartLegendItem[]; // Manual legend items (overrides auto-generation)
  type?: "circle" | "dashed" | "line"; // Indicator shape for auto-generated items. Default: "circle"
  dataHead?: boolean; // Show DataHead block in auto-generated items. Default: false
  dataHeadConfig?: {
    dataLeadValue?: number | string;
    dataSupportingValue?: number | string;
    supportingLabelValue?: string;
    supportingData?: boolean;
    supportingLabel?: boolean;
  };
  /** Updates legend item(s) DataHead lead value on hover. Requires `dataHead: true`.
   * "individual"/"categorical" hoverType updates only the hovered series; "group"
   * hoverType updates every series at once with that category's breakdown. */
  interactiveDataHead?: boolean;
  formatHoverSupportingLabel?: (category: CategoryValue, seriesIndex: number) => string;
  size?: "XS" | "S" | "M" | "L" | "XL"; // Typography size variant for the whole legend
  ariaLabel?: string;
  ariaLabelledBy?: string;
}
```

| ---------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

With `barGroupConfig.hoverType: "individual"` or `"categorical"`, only the hovered series' legend item updates. With `hoverType: "group"`, every legend item updates together with that category's per-series breakdown |
| `formatHoverSupportingLabel` | `(category: CategoryValue, seriesIndex: number) => string`   | `undefined` | Custom formatter for the supporting label text shown on hover                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `size`                       | `"XS" \| "S" \| "M" \| "L" \| "XL"`                           | `undefined` | Typography size variant. Controls legend item scaling                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `ariaLabel`                  | `string`                                                      | `undefined` | Forwarded to ChartLegend's aria-label                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |

#### Interactive legend (per-series hover value)

`chartLegendConfig.interactiveDataHead` drives auto-generated legend items' DataHead lead values from hover state — mirroring `VerticalStackedBarChart`'s equivalent behaviour. Behaviour depends on `barGroupConfig.hoverType`:

- `"individual"` / `"categorical"` (segment-level hover): only the hovered series' legend item updates; the others keep their static `dataHeadConfig.dataLeadValue`.
- `"group"` (whole-bar hover): every series' value for the hovered category is looked up from `data` and all legend items update together.

```tsx
<HorizontalStackedBarChart
  data={data}
  chartLegendConfig={{
    dataHead: true,
    dataHeadConfig: { dataLeadValue: 1234, supportingLabelValue: 'Total' },
    interactiveDataHead: true,
    formatHoverSupportingLabel: (category) => `${category} contribution`,
  }}
  barGroupConfig={{ hoverType: 'individual' }}
/>
```

### DataDisplayConfig

```typescript
interface DataDisplayConfig {
  // Chart-specific behaviour
  mode?: "static" | "hover"; // Default: "static"
  formatHoverLeadValue?: (value: number, category?: CategoryValue, segmentIndex?: number) => string;
  formatHoverBadgeValue?: (
    value: number,
    category?: CategoryValue,
    segmentIndex?: number
  ) => string;

  // DataDisplay Layer 2 props (forwarded directly)
  mainLabelValue?: string;
  alignment?: "Left" | "Center"; // Default: "Left"
  rightBadgeWrapper?: boolean; // Default: true
  badgeTop?: boolean; // Default: false
  badgeBottom?: boolean; // Default: true
  showBadge?: boolean; // Default: true
  supportingBadgeLabel?: boolean; // Default: true
  supportingBadgeLabelValue?: string;
  size?: "XS" | "S" | "M" | "L" | "XL"; // Default: "L"

  // DataDisplay Layer 3 configs
  dataHead?: DataHeadConfig; // See DataDisplay.md
  badgeConfig?: BadgeConfig; // See DataDisplay.md
}
```

When `mode` is `"hover"`, `mainLabelValue`, `dataHead.dataLeadValue`, and `badgeConfig.value` update dynamically as segments are hovered — driven by `formatHoverLeadValue`/`formatHoverBadgeValue`.

### BarGroupConfig

```typescript
interface BarGroupConfig {
  rightLabelOutside?: boolean; // Show value labels outside the bar on the right (default: false)
  categoryLabel?: boolean; // Show category labels on the left (default: true)
  xAxis?: boolean; // Show the X-axis at the bottom (default: false)
  valueFormat?: ValueFormatConfig;
  barHeight?: string; // "XS" | "S" | "M" | "L" | "XL" | "2XL"
  barWidthMode?: BarWidthMode; // "fullWidth" | "relative" (default: "relative")
  dataSort?: DataSortOrder; // "asc" | "desc" | "unsorted" (default: "unsorted")
  hoverType?: StackedBarHoverType;

  onBarHover?: (data: HorizontalStackedBarHoverData) => void;
  onBarClick?: (data: HorizontalStackedBarHoverData) => void;
  /** Back-compat alias for `highlightedBarIndices`. */
  hoveredBarIndex?: number | number[];
  /** Indices of bars rendered at full opacity; every other bar dims. */
  highlightedBarIndices?: number[];
  hoveredSegmentIndex?: number | null;
  xAxisConfig?: XAxisConfig; // { tickCount, formatValue, xAxisLabel, xAxisLabelValue }
  hoverBadgeConfig?: HoverBadgeConfig; // { formatValue, formatBadge, preset }
  autoHeight?: boolean; // Collapse chart to fit bars + X-axis naturally; removes void for sparse data (default: false)
  overflowType?: "truncated" | "all"; // Overflow handling (default: "truncated")
}
```

## Usage Examples

### Basic Usage

```tsx
import { HorizontalStackedBarChart } from "./charts/HorizontalStackedBarChart";

const data = [
  { category: "Q1", series: "Product A", value: 30 },
  { category: "Q1", series: "Product B", value: 25 },
  { category: "Q2", series: "Product A", value: 35 },
  { category: "Q2", series: "Product B", value: 30 },
];

<HorizontalStackedBarChart
  data={data}
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: "Quarterly Sales",
    chartSubtitleValue: "Breakdown by product category.",
  }}
/>;
```

### With DataDisplay (Hover Mode)

```tsx
<HorizontalStackedBarChart
  data={data}
  dataDisplay={true}
  barGroupConfig={{ hoverType: "individual" }}
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: "hover",
    mainLabelValue: "Hover a segment",
    dataHead: { dataLeadValue: "—", supportingData: false },
    badgeConfig: { value: "—", appearance: "positive" },
  }}
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: "Revenue by Product",
    chartSubtitleValue: "Hover over segments to see details.",
  }}
/>
```

```tsx
<HorizontalStackedBarChart
```

## Design Tokens Used

| Property      | Variable Name           | Fallback | Description                |
| ------------- | ----------------------- | -------- | -------------------------- |
| Container Gap | `Dimensions/Spacings/5` | `20px`   | Gap between chart sections |
| Color 1-6     | `categorical/bold/{n}`  | Various  | Segment colors             |

## Legend Auto-Generation

When `chartLegend` is `true` and `chartLegendConfig.items` is not provided, legend items are auto-generated from the unique series names in the data. Each series maps to a categorical color (`categorical/bold/1` through `categorical/bold/6`).

The legend automatically hides when only a single series is detected (non-stacked data), since a one-item legend is redundant. It reappears when 2+ series are present. Manually provided `chartLegendConfig.items` are always shown regardless of series count.

## Height Behavior

The `height` prop controls the total chart container height. `HorizontalStackedBarGroup` fills the remaining vertical space after header, legend, DataDisplay, and footer via a `flex: 1` wrapper.

### `autoHeight` — sparse data without the void

With 1–3 rows, the default `flex: 1` wrapper stretches the bar group to fill the full fixed `height`. The X-axis is pushed to the very bottom of that fixed container, leaving a large empty void between the single bar and the axis.

Set `barGroupConfig.autoHeight: true` to collapse the wrapper:

- The chart container height is set to `undefined` (collapses to content).
- The `barGroupWrapper` switches from `flex: 1` to `flex: 0 0 auto`.
- `HorizontalStackedBarGroup` receives `height: undefined` so it sizes to its natural content.

```tsx
<HorizontalStackedBarChart
  data={singleRowData}
  barGroupConfig={{ autoHeight: true, barHeight: "L" }}
/>
```

> **Do not** set a fixed `height` together with `autoHeight: true` — the fixed height is intentionally ignored when `autoHeight` is active.

## Bar Overflow

The chart dynamically limits the number of visible bars to prevent overcrowding. Controlled by the `overflowType` prop in `barGroupConfig`.

The component measures the content area height via `ResizeObserver` and computes the maximum number of bars that fit while maintaining a minimum gap equal to **the bar height** between adjacent bars. When the gap would fall below this threshold, bottom bars are silently removed.

| Type          | Behaviour                                                                        |
| ------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `"truncated"` | (Default) Bars that don't fit are removed from the bottom                        |
| `"all"`       | Every bar is rendered regardless of available space (preserves legacy behaviour) |

Sorting (`dataSort`) is applied before truncation, so with `dataSort: "desc"` the highest-value bars remain visible.

```tsx
// Default: bars automatically truncated when they don't fit
<HorizontalStackedBarChart
  data={data}
  height={300}
  barGroupConfig={{ barHeight: "M" }}
/>

// Show all bars regardless of space
<HorizontalStackedBarChart
  data={data}
  height={300}
  barGroupConfig={{ overflowType: "all" }}
/>
```

## Hover Interaction

### Hover Types

| Type            | Description                                            |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `"group"`       | All segments in a bar highlight together               |
| `"individual"`  | Only the hovered segment highlights                    |
| `"categorical"` | Same segment index across all bars highlights together |

## Hover Badge

Enable via `barGroupConfig.hoverBadge`. The DataBadge follows the cursor when hovering over bar segments. Use `barGroupConfig.hoverBadgeConfig` for custom formatting:

- `hoverBadgeConfig.formatValue` — custom value formatter
- `hoverBadgeConfig.formatBadge` — structured formatter for multi-section hover badges
- `hoverBadgeConfig.preset` — preset configuration (e.g., `"chartKeys"` for per-series color-keyed breakdown)

## DataDisplay Integration

This chart supports an optional DataDisplay component positioned between ChartLegend and the group component. Toggle visibility with the `dataDisplay` boolean prop and configure via `dataDisplayConfig`. See **[DataDisplay Integration](./DataDisplayIntegration.md)** for full configuration including static/hover modes, custom formatters, and requirements.

**Note**: For this chart, formatters receive `(value: number, category?: string, segmentIndex?: number)` where `segmentIndex` identifies which segment (0-5) was hovered.

## Accessibility

Wrapped by `ChartAccessibility` (enabled by default). Provides `role="figure"`, auto-generated summaries, hidden data tables, and an ARIA live region. See **[ChartAccessibility.md](./ChartAccessibility.md)** for configuration.

### ARIA Live Region

The chart uses `useChartAccessibility` (which composes `useAriaLiveRegion` internally) to announce hovered data to screen readers. The announcement is debounced (150ms) to prevent flooding during rapid keyboard navigation.

**Announcement format**: `"{category} {segmentLabel}, {value}, {pct}% of total"` -- e.g. `"Q1 Product A, 30, 40.0% of total"`. When no segment label is available (group hover), the format is `"{category}, {value}, {pct}% of total"`.

### aria-controls Chain

When `dataDisplay={true}`, bars declare `aria-controls` pointing to the DataDisplay component's `id`. This tells assistive technology which region updates when a bar is focused.

```
HorizontalStackedBarChart
  └─ dataDisplayId ← useChartAccessibility({ ... })
       ├─ <DataDisplay id={dataDisplayId} />
       └─ <HorizontalStackedBarGroup ariaControlsId={dataDisplayId}>
            └─ <HorizontalStackedBar ariaControls={dataDisplayId} />
```

### Keyboard Navigation

Bars are navigable with ArrowUp/ArrowDown via `useRovingTabIndex` (see [HorizontalStackedBarGroup.md](./HorizontalStackedBarGroup.md)). Keyboard focus triggers the same visual hover effects and ARIA live announcements as mouse hover.
